Title: 488623-2026: Italy – Construction of aircraft maintenance hangars – Venaria Reale (TO) - M. Santi Airport (ID 810) - Construction of a new hangar, aprons and service building
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of a hangar is highly relevant, as large-span structures such as hangars are among the priorities and this also includes aprons and service buildings. Points deducted due to the location in Italy (not the DACH region) and the lack of any indication of checking engineer services in Germany.
titel: Venaria Reale - M. Santi Airport - New construction of a hangar, aprons and service building
kurzbeschreibung: New construction of an aircraft hangar with aprons and a service building at Venaria Reale Airport.
umfang: Construction works for a new aircraft maintenance hangar as well as associated apron areas and a service building at M. Santi Airport; estimated contract value EUR 30,538,331.95 net; execution period 735 days until 31.12.2029. No technical parameters such as spans, areas or GFA stated.
leistungen: Construction works for the realization of a new hangar, apron areas and a service building; no explicit planning services or HOAI service phases stated.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Hangar buildings can in principle be of interest to sbp due to potentially large-span structures.
• However, the notice text contains no information on spans, structural system, material or architectural distinctiveness.
• The tender is primarily for construction works, not for planning or structural design services.
• With over EUR 30 million, the project volume is economically relevant.
• The international location in Italy is in principle compatible with sbp’s activity profile.
• Due to the lack of technical details and the lack of explicit planning focus, only medium relevance.
baukosten_erklaerung: Taken directly from the tender notice.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee for planning services stated; construction works are tendered. Without information on any planning share or remuneration structure, no reliable estimate for sbp is possible.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria according to the tender documents; no specific reference or qualification requirements are stated in the notice itself.
zuschlagskriterien: Quality; no detailed weighting stated, described as OEPV.
auftraggeber: COMANDO INFRASTRUTTURE, Viale dell'Esercito 123, 00100 Rome, Italy, E-mail: comgenio@postacert.difesa.it, Tel.: +390650236038
notes: Restricted procedure under defence procurement law. CPV 45213351 Construction of aircraft maintenance hangars. Estimated value net EUR 30,538,331.95. Option mentioned: quinto d'obbligo. Tenders only in Italian via https://www.acquistinretepa.it.
